title: Bank account verification scam
text: We detected suspicious activity on your bank account. Verify your account immediately at http://secure-bank.verify.example and provide your account number and password.

title: Fake invoice PDF
text: Please find attached invoice INV-0923. Click the link to view and pay immediately to avoid penalties.

title: Prize/phishing text
text: Congratulations! You have won a prize. Send your UPI ID or a small verification transfer of $1 to claim the reward.
